description: Registry of lawful absences among repository paths cited by README.md and docs/*.md. Companion to src/audit_doc_path_references.py (fourth standalone auditor spawned by verify_retained_integrity.py --auditors). Every repository-rooted path cited in backticks or relative markdown links across the current-facing documentation surfaces must exist on disk OR be registered here with a reason class and machine-checked evidence. Registered paths are asserted to remain ABSENT (tripwire: a permanently-unused registered path coming into existence stops the wake). Scope decision: superseded/ and results/, failed-designs/ internal documents are archival surfaces and are neither scanned nor required to resolve.

counts_at_registration.note: The registration sweep recognised backtick code spans only (300 unique document/citation pairs, 20 absent pairs over 13 distinct absent citation strings). The auditor additionally recognises relative markdown links on the scanned prefixes; its first live audit at the registering commit measured 305 unique pairs.

registered_absences.reason: The 312,139,776-byte raw compressibility artifact exceeds the hosting platform's hard per-file limit and was migrated same-day into results/host-compressibility-long-window-360001x10ms.parts/ under a binding MANIFEST.json (per-part offsets and SHA-256 digests, reassembly rule, original SHA-256 authoritative), round-trip verified byte-exact before commit per docs/history-migration-2026-08-22.md. The five citing documents predate the migration and their citations are preserved exactly as written.

Its shakedown feasibility gate FAILED (A=102 supercritical 20/24, A=204 7/24, joint complete pairs 3/24), so no retained run was ever authorised into this path; the signed-bracket preregistration records it verbatim as 'never used - its retained run was not authorised'. The archived gate no-go is the binding evidence; the directory was never created.

The output-schema document describes the planned format for the run that never happened and is retained as written.

Its pre-freeze feasibility gate FAILED (0/24 G1, G2), was archived with evidence, and the directory was never created. Both citing schema documents describe the planned output format for the run that never happened and are retained as written.

The design was repaired before any retained run and the executed, retained, post-audited outputs live at results/stage8-alpha-evolution-paired/ under the repair preregistration's fresh path; the original unpaired path was never created. No commit in the entire repository history has ever contained a file at this path (git log --all verified empty at registration), while the companion output results/offspring-first-extraction-threshold-summary.json is retained on disk. The citation is historical provenance prose inside a preserved assay document and is reconciled by this registration rather than by editing the archived text.
